title: Dolphin Ride
description: Dolphin ride, as a dolphin ride preset, is impossible tourism played straight: a body mounted on a sea creature, bright water, honest horizon, splash readable. The gag is the vehicle, and swimming near a dolphin is not the sentence.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Vacation myths, dream logistics, a postcard that cannot be true: the face is serious or delighted but not winking. Wide enough to see the animal as the engine.
Documentary camera on a miracle nobody should file as nature. It is the wrong tool for a respectful wildlife film, and the wrong tool if the person is only nearby in the water.
Penguin ride is the ice version. Puffin ride leaves the water for cliffs.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Wide, horizon honest, camera at rider height or slightly off the water, 24mm to 35mm. Bright sun, speculars on water, splash as physical spray.
The person is mounted, moving, animal readable. No logos.
Still: Dolphin-ride of [Subject], a body carried by a sea creature, impossible tourism, joy as a gag. Video: [Subject] rides a dolphin through bright water, a tourist miracle.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: A gag, a vacation myth, a dream commute across water. Do not use it in a nature documentary that wants respect, and do not stage a swim-beside.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Big Miracle and other rescue dramas give honest water and animal bodies. Viral AI rides are the well-known use of the mounted gag.
Play it as a postcard that cannot be true, not as a copied still.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: A person swimming near a dolphin, or a wink to camera. The tell is no mount and no engine.
Fix it: they are on the animal, the animal is moving, spray in the air, face played straight.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Dolphin Ride in film?
A straight-faced mount gag: a person riding a dolphin through bright water. Documentary camera, impossible tourism. Nearby swimming does not count.
Dolphin Ride vs Penguin Ride
Dolphin ride is sea, splash, a cetacean engine. Penguin ride is ice or a wrong city, flightless mount. Same postcard law, different animal physics.
When should I use Dolphin Ride?
Gags, vacation myths, dream travel. Skip respectful wildlife coverage.
How do I prompt Dolphin Ride for AI image or video?

Wide water, mounted [Subject], then: Dolphin-ride of [Subject], a body carried by a sea creature, impossible tourism, joy as a gag. For video: [Subject] rides a dolphin through bright water. Face committed. No logos.
